slides.chapter: 01. The Golden Rule of Hot Springs
slides.spoken_text: 湯船に入る前に、かけ湯で体を洗い流してください。
slides.meaning: Before getting into the bath, please rinse and wash your body thoroughly.
slides.tip: Never step into the communal bath water without thoroughly rinsing first.

tokens.kana: あらいながしてください

slides.sentence_ja: 湯船に入る前に、かけ湯で体を洗い流してください。
slides.grammar_title: Time Sequence Pattern: Verb (Dictionary Form) + 前に (Before Doing)
grammar_bullets: The communal bath tub (湯船) is strictly for soaking—all soaping and scrubbing happens at individual stalls.
Small privacy towels must never touch the hot spring water—rest them on your head or edge of the tub.
Wipe your body dry with your towel before stepping back into the changing room (脱衣所).
Drinking chilled fruit milk (フルーツ牛乳) after soaking is a cherished Tokyo sento tradition.
